violations.text: The floors in the walk-in cooler were observed in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/29/2026

An open employees' beverage container was observed stored in a food preparation area. Employees shall not drink from open beverage containers in order to prevent contamination of their hands, the container, and exposed food. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Service call was placed during time of inspection. Establishment must sanitize all dishes in 3 bay sink until dishmachine is properly adjusted. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of equipment such as freezers have an accumulation of black residue on tracks and gaskets and ice accumulation in interior chests. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026
The floors in the walk-in cooler were observed in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/29/2026

Open employees' beverage containers were observed stored in a food preparation area. Employees shall not drink from open beverage containers in order to prevent contamination of their hands, the container, and exposed food. PIC informed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

An employee was observed peeling ready to eat food hard boiled eggs with bare hands. Food employees must not touch exposed, ready-to-eat food with their bare hands and shall use suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, single use gloves, or dispensing equipment. Hard boiled eggs will be consumed by owner, per PIC. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

Food contact surfaces of the slicer were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Slicer was cleaned and sanitized during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

Food contact surfaces of the ice machine were observed with an accumulation of pink and black biofilm. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice was voluntarily disposed of. Ice machine to be thoroughly washed rinsed and sanitized prior to use. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Service call was placed during time of inspection. Establishment must sanitize all dishes in 3 bay sink until dishmachine is properly adjusted. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of equipment such as freezers have an accumulation of black residue on tracks and gaskets and ice accumulation in interior chests. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026
The floors in the walk-in cooler were observed in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/29/2026
No person certified in food safety was present as needed at the time of inspection. Per PIC, additional staff is in process of obtaining food safety certificate. New Violation. Correct By: 05/29/2025

Food, beverages, and single service items were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and/or basement. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 05/29/2025

The following was observed in poor repair: 1. gaskets at 2 door lowboy at front counter 2. gaskets at chest freezer in kitchen 3. gaskets at reach-in freezer in basement Equipment to be in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 06/29/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: 1. ice machine 2. shelving in walk-in cooler 3. fanguards in walk-in 4. under prep unit lids and on sides 5. various reach-in/chest freezers (ice accumulation) 6. interior and exterior of dishmachine New Violation. Correct By: 06/12/2025
The kitchen hood vents have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 06/29/2025
The floors in the walk-in cooler were observed in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 05/29/2026
Ice Machine was observed with an accumulation of unidentifiable black substance. Ice Machine needs to be cleaned. New Violation. Correct By: 11/07/2023
Food items stored in buckets were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 11/07/2023

The non-food contact surfaces of the lower level shelving of large prep table in kitchen, white bins for dried ingredients, walls and celling in walk-in have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Cardboard was observed on walk-in floor. Cardboard was observed black with food debris on it. Cardboard shall be replaced daily. New Violation. Correct By: 11/07/2023
